visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man is kneeling on a vast, snow-covered slope under a bright, clear sky. He wears a distinctive purple and black jacket with the "OAKLEY" logo across the chest, a black helmet with colorful goggles, and black gloves. Behind him, the terrain rolls down into a valley where a distant town and more snow-peaked mountains are visible. He looks directly at the camera, talking and gesturing with his gloved hands. (2) The scene transitions to the man standing upright on his snowboard. He checks his equipment and looks down the slope, preparing for his run. The lighting is bright and natural, highlighting the texture of the packed snow. (3) He begins to slide down the mountain. The camera follows him in a tracking shot, capturing his movements as he maneuvers his board. He passes a small, bare bush in the middle of the run, demonstrating control. The background landscape shifts as he descends, showing more of the expansive snowy hills. (4) He finishes his run and sits back down on the snow in a kneeling position. He smiles and gestures towards the camera, delivering concluding remarks. The distant skyline and mountain peaks remain clear in the background.

visual_human_presence.mainCharacterDescription: A male snowboarder wearing a purple and black Oakley brand snow jacket, black pants, black helmet with iridescent goggles, and black gloves.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: A wide, open snow-covered mountain slope during the day. In the distance, multiple layers of snow-capped mountains and a valley containing an urban settlement are visible under a clear blue sky. A ski lift structure is partially visible in the initial frame.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male voice speaks with high energy and a friendly, welcoming tone in Mandarin. An upbeat acoustic pop track plays concurrently, featuring rhythmic guitar strumming and a steady kick-drum beat. The sound of light wind indicates an outdoor mountain environment. (2) As the speaker explains technical snowboarding tips, the vocal intensity remains consistent with conversational loudness. A faint rustle of heavy fabric is heard as he gestures. The music maintains a constant tempo of approximately 100 BPM. (3) The acoustic environment shifts as a new phase begins when the board begins to move. A distinct, continuous percussive sliding sound (snow crunching and hissing) dominates the mid-frequencies. The speaker's voice becomes shorter and slightly more breathy as he navigates the slope. (4) The sliding sounds cease, replaced by the sound of the speaker sitting in the snow. He delivers a concluding message with a cheerful, high-valence tone. The background music continues at its original volume before a gradual fade-out at the very end of the recording.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Introduction -> Technique Keypoints -> Action Demonstration -> Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: This video serves as an educational snowboarding tutorial. A professional coach provides specific advice for riding through tree-filled or wooded terrain, emphasizing the importance of lowering one's center of gravity and maintaining bodily flexibility for safety and control.
